name: Ants: flips between sources against self-conversion
description: How often the colony flips between sources: flips (from one source holding 80 % to the other) in 20 000 steps (10⁶ meetings) against ε, 100 ants, δ 0.01. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-27): 13, 25, 34, 44, 69 at ε 0.001, 0.002, 0.003, 0.005, 0.01. More self-conversion, more flips — until ε passes (1 − δ)/(N − 1) = 0.01 and the colony stops crowding one source at all.
